19 of them are special needs plans. Of the other 51, 43 include drug coverage and 8 do not. All special needs plans include drug coverage. Special needs plans are only for people who qualify, such as people with both Medicare and Medicaid.

Not every plan is offered everywhere. CMS lists between 30 and 57 plans in each county, counting special needs plans. 8 companies offer Medicare Advantage plans in West Virginia. One of them offers only special needs plans.

In September 2026, 56.6% of people with Medicare in West Virginia were in a Medicare Advantage plan.

Plan counts: CMS 2027 plan list, November 2026 update. Share: CMS, September 2026. Plan lists can change as contracts are finalized; confirm on Medicare.gov before you enroll.

Schedule a Medicare Advantage review

Booking opens Luay’s page on PlanEnroll. Create your profile there and ask for your meeting. Having these ready makes the first conversation useful:

  • Your Medicare card, or the dates your Part A and Part B start.
  • The doctors and hospitals you want to keep.
  • A list of your prescriptions and the pharmacy you use.
  • Whether you have Medicaid or get help paying Medicare costs.

When PlanEnroll asks what type of meeting you would like, choose Health. You may be asked to complete a short Scope of Appointment form first. It does not obligate you to enroll. The first open time is at least 24 hours ahead. To talk sooner, call (301) 615-8289.

When you can join or switch

  • Initial Enrollment Period. Most people can first join a plan when they turn 65. This window lasts 7 months. It starts 3 months before the month you turn 65 and ends 3 months after that month.
  • Open Enrollment Period. Each year from October 15 to December 7, you can join, switch or drop a Medicare Advantage plan. The change starts January 1.
  • Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period. If you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, you can switch plans or go back to Original Medicare from January 1 to March 31.

See when you can change Medicare plans in West Virginia for special enrollment periods and the Medigap rules that apply.

How we help you choose

The number of plans matters less than whether a plan fits you. We check that your doctors and hospitals are in the plan’s network, look up each of your prescriptions, and compare the total yearly cost of the plans we offer, not only the premium. If you have both Medicare and Medicaid, we check whether a special needs plan fits. See how Medicare Advantage works and Medicare Supplement, the main alternative.

Free counseling and your state regulator

West Virginia’s State Health Insurance Assistance Program, WV SHIP, gives free, unbiased Medicare counseling and does not sell insurance. The West Virginia Offices of the Insurance Commissioner regulates insurance in West Virginia and can verify an agent’s license.

Common questions

West Virginia Medicare Advantage FAQ

How many Medicare Advantage plans are in West Virginia for 2027?
For 2027, CMS lists 70 Medicare Advantage plans offered in West Virginia. Not every plan is offered everywhere. CMS lists between 30 and 57 plans in each county, counting special needs plans.
Do all Medicare Advantage plans include drug coverage?
No. Of the 70 Medicare Advantage plans CMS lists in West Virginia for 2027, 19 are special needs plans, and all of those include drug coverage. Of the other 51, 43 include drug coverage and 8 do not.
Who can join a special needs plan?
Special needs plans are only for people who qualify, such as people with both Medicare and Medicaid.
When can I join or switch a Medicare Advantage plan?
Most people can first join when they turn 65, during a 7-month window. Each year from October 15 to December 7 you can join, switch or drop a plan, and the change starts January 1. If you are already in a Medicare Advantage plan, you can switch plans or go back to Original Medicare from January 1 to March 31.
Does it cost anything to use Honorbrook?
No. Carriers pay us when you enroll, and your premium is the same whether you use an agent or enroll on your own. We do not offer every plan available in your area.
